description: This PHP class defines the EmployeeProfilePictureController, a controller within the OrangeHRM system responsible for handling employee profile picture operations. It manages rendering the profile picture component and setting necessary permissions, primarily for viewing and uploading employee photographs.

classes.name: EmployeeProfilePictureController
classes.description: Controller class that manages employee profile picture data and rendering, extending base view controller functionalities.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component with employee data and permissions before rendering the view.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the data groups necessary for capability permission checks, specifically for photographs.
